diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~338% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. A few outliers stand out (269 points, ~12% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.337), which favours a weighted combination.
